# Clean org fixture

A four-dossier org that satisfies all nine AS-33 rules: one board report
(`agent:fix-ceo`), no orphans, no cycles, nobody under an `ic`, every class and
status valid, no duplicate identities, nothing unparsed. This file has no
leading `---` fence, so it must be skipped silently and must NOT produce an
`unparsed_dossier` violation — that asymmetry is part of what the fixture pins.

These are fixtures for apps/chat tests only. They are not employees.
